title: After a TermAl restart, a session's named source root is gone: evaluation refused "TermAl has no named source root (it reads the session's workdir)"
outcome: An evaluation requested after a host restart either finds the session's existing named source root, if naming is meant to persist, or refuses with a typed remedy that names the supported recovery (re-name in a claim-focused turn, then evaluate on the next turn), instead of a generic "request again once the root has settled".
acceptance: Whether a session's source-root naming is meant to survive a host restart is decided and documented.

If it should persist: a test restarts the host with a named root and shows that an evaluation finds the same root and generation. If it should not: the refusal names the exact recovery steps, and a test pins that text.
The existing named-root binding and sighting rules are otherwise unchanged.
